message.content:
Based on the screenshot, here is a description of the open panel:

**Panel Title and Status**
The panel is titled **"Choose a model"**. It is currently in an **empty state**, indicated by the header **"Model: not chosen yet"** at the top of the view.

**Sections and Content**
The panel contains the following sections and text:

*   **Introduction:**
    > "The model is the engine that reads your instructions and does the work. Switching models keeps this task — its objective, its plan, and everything it produced — exactly as it is."

*   **Empty State Message (No List of Models):**
    Instead of a list, there is a section titled **"No models connected yet"** with the following explanation:
    > "A model is what does the work of a task — reading your instructions, writing, analyzing, and planning. Different models bring different strengths; for example, some can understand images. Models become available when you connect a provider."

*   **Instructions ("What to do next"):**
    This section provides the exact steps to resolve the empty state:
    > "To make models available, connect a provider: open Settings, then Connections, and follow the steps there. Models from connected providers appear in this panel, ready to run your tasks."

*   **Action Button:**
    There is a blue button labeled **"Open Connections settings."**

*   **Footer Information:**
    *   "Applies to 'Untitled task' — switching never starts a new task"
    *   "Escape closes this panel"
    *   A collapsed section titled **"* Capabilities"** with the subtitle "What a task can do — and what's missing when it can't".
